titulo: Incognito mode is not as private as you think 🕵️
descripcion: Incognito only stops your own browser from saving history. Websites, your internet provider and the Wi-Fi owner can still see your traffic.

escenas.texto: You open an incognito window and feel invisible. You're not.
Incognito only does one thing: your browser doesn't save your history, cookies or form data after you close it.
But the websites you visit still see you. Your internet provider still sees where you go. And so can the owner of the Wi-Fi network, like your school or job.
And if you log into an account, that site knows exactly who you are.
Incognito is for hiding things from people who use your device. Not from the internet. Follow for more tech truths.
